title:
A huge well done to our Project Lead Nathan, who ran a marathon this weekend “dressed as a Chicken 🐔 “ to raise money for our fundraising 

Nathan took part in the Delamere Forest - Marathon and completed it in  Time: 5:09:03

All your colleagues and the tenants at Blue Pits Housing Action are extremely proud 😊
